sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live visa-on-arrival nationality endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The live kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw endpoint is served by the Ministry of Interior's current Kuwait Visa platform and returns the application's country objects.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: Terms and Conditions

sources.supportingExcerpt: The maximum allowed stay for the visa holder is 90 days

sources.title: KUNA: Amiri decree issued new law concerning foreigners' residency
sources.officialityEvidence: KUNA is Kuwait's official news agency reporting the 2024 Amiri residency decree and its Ministry of Interior implementation rules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: GCC citizens were exempted from needing a valid passport to enter and leave Kuwait

sources.title: KUNA: MoI new e-visa system and tourist-visa categories
sources.officialityEvidence: KUNA reports the Ministry of Interior's August 2025 presentation of the current Kuwait Visa system and tourist-visa eligibility categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: GCC, skilled professionals, the US, UK, or Schengen residency holders

sources.title: Kuwait International Airport: Visa Services
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official DGCA airport page directs arriving travellers to the Ministry of Interior Kuwait Visa platform for visa services.

policies.title: Kuwaiti nationals: outside foreign visitor scope
policies.summary: A Kuwaiti ordinary passport belongs to a Kuwaiti citizen and is not a foreign visitor-visa case.
conditions: This does not decide dual-national document choice, foreign residence, exit, security, or individual admission treatment.

policies.title: GCC citizens: visa-free entry using national identification
policies.summary: Kuwait's 2024 residency-law report says GCC citizens may enter and leave Kuwait using their national identity cards under Ministry of Interior regulations and inter-state agreements; this is normalized as visa_free rather than a resident or sponsor visa.
conditions: This is a GCC-citizenship right for Bahraini, Omani, Qatari, Saudi and UAE nationals. It is not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival route and does not extend to a non-GCC passport holder merely resident in a GCC state.

The cited report makes the national-ID entry right subject to Ministry of Interior regulations and agreements with the relevant GCC states; identity, border, security and individual-admission requirements remain applicable.
This ordinary-passport classification does not establish work, study, residence, family, companion, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, emergency-document or other special-case treatment.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Ministry of Interior Kuwait Visa endpoint explicitly marks these 53 nationality records as visaOnArrival.
conditions: The current endpoint establishes visa-on-arrival eligibility for these nationalities but does not itself state a complete purpose, document, duration, passport-type or port-condition schedule. This record does not manufacture conditions absent from that source.

The Ministry of Interior online-visa terms separately require online applicants to use the official site, normally have a passport valid for six months, provide specified travel documents, and observe a maximum 90-day stay unless the issued visa says otherwise. Those online-application conditions are not treated as a replacement for the available arrival route.

Any eVisa alternative, and any entry route based on residence, profession, sponsor, family, employment, study, transit, diplomatic or special-document facts, is separate from this nationality-wide ordinary-passport arrival classification.
Issuance or entry remains subject to Ministry of Interior security review and border discretion.
